# Designful

Designful is an AI design studio that sells one-time AI design deliverables for a flat $49 per feature. Every feature offers a free preview of real output (watermarked where it includes images); you pay only if the preview impresses you. No agency, no retainer, no subscription. All sales are final. Full commercial rights on everything produced. Provider: MehyarSoft LLC (https://mehyar.us).

## Key pages

- / — landing page: free previews, feature catalog, pricing, FAQ, studio work gallery
- /feature.html — feature detail pages (query ?f=): homepage-teardown, logo-refresh, ad-creative-pack, social-launch-kit, hero-rewrite
- /work.html — the studio collection: real sample output, every piece shoppable at $49
- /success.html — post-Stripe order confirmation (not indexed); polls payment status
- /deliverable.html — the buyer's private deliverable page (token-gated, not indexed)
- /privacy.html — privacy policy
- /terms.html — terms of service
- /llms.txt — this file

## Pricing

$49 one-time per feature (Stripe, via the centralized https://mehyar.us/api/pay/checkout). Bundles: any 3 features for $99, Full Studio Pass (all 5) for $149 — all one-time. No subscription. All sales are final. Buyer owns the output with full commercial rights, forever.

## API

- POST /api/designful/teaser — free: { feature, inputs } → watermarked real-output preview per feature. KV rate-limited per IP.
- POST /api/designful/generate — paid: { order_token, feature, inputs } → full paid deliverable manifest. Gated on the order access token; idempotent per feature.
- GET /api/designful/deliverable?token= — token-gated buyer manifest JSON.
- POST /api/subscribe — { email, phone?, zip?, sms_consent? } newsletter signup. One short email when new work ships; unsubscribe anytime.

## Compliance

Designful makes no income, traffic, conversion, or business-outcome promises; it does not claim human designers touch the work (large language models plus image models with structured recipes), does not claim mobile/speed aspects it labels "not assessable from inputs," and never sells, trains on, or reuses buyer inputs or brands without permission. Review stars and reactions shown on-site as SAMPLE are illustrative placeholders, not real customer reviews — real customer reviews replace them after launch. "Typical agency $2,000+ / 4+ weeks" and "typical freelancer $300+ / about a week" are rough market comparisons; outside quotes vary. Paid deliverables ship clean and full-resolution; free previews are watermarked and display-size-limited.
